finalists.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including a tender swelling, skin fistula, and orange peel appearance, despite some normal inflammatory markers and cultures.

finalists.label: Breast Cancer
finalists.why: It is supported by imaging findings, including an ACR-4 lesion and multiple oval and rounded lesions with irregular thick walls, although it is less specific than Inflammatory breast cancer.

finalists.label: Granulomatous Mastitis
finalists.why: It has some specific findings, including a tender swelling and normal inflammatory markers and cultures, but it is less decisive than Inflammatory breast cancer.

frontier_selector.why: The development of a skin fistula with pus extruding and an orange peel appearance, along with the presence of a tender swelling and nipple retraction, are more specific to Inflammatory breast cancer than to Granulomatous Mastitis.
